text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Flawless running from Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Verxina's sister!
Looks like she's going to grow even more from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Pheeew...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa,
I didn't think it'd be this exhausting...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Still, is it just me,
or is everyone looking at me?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*
Time to show my stuff!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, thanks for your support!
Um, you see, I, Vivlos—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm going down the Tiara route~♡

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...! You're going to follow right in Verxina's footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand is on the Classic Triple Crown route, right?
Which means the one who'll avenge Verxina is—

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. In other words...
Now I'm getting my hopes up, Vivlos...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
—The unfulfilled dream she carried...
Vivlos will...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trai-ny~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos,
I'm back!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
That's all~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know, I worked really hard in the race!
So... could you praise me a wiiittle bit more?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Trainy, are you
really bad at spoiling people?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
keep getting better and better, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aren't I super amazing?
Think I can just keep this up and take on the Tiara route?
Aside from Dubai, her other objective—the Triple Tiara route races—would take place from the spring to autumn of the following Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, do you usually squeeze races in between?
Big Sis ran in graded races and stuff too, right!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then shall we pick
our next target race?
Vivlos's body hasn't fully matured yet. Even today, right after the race, she showed much more severe exhaustion than the other girls.

If that's the case, we should first focus on completing your physique
and avoid centering your schedule around fierce races—
choice_data_list: I want to focus on training until early next spring.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's an option too!
I'm totally fine with that, you know?
choice_data_list: Let's pick our next races once spring is over.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
You mean the first Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Don't tell me you're worried we won't even make it in time for the Triple Tiara route!?
choice_data_list: I think it should be fine for the most part, though.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Basically~!?
Tell me for sure that it's going to be okay~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Triple Tiara
and get revenge for my big sis~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And once I'm all properly sparkly, that's when I'll head to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah,
you understand me so well♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then I'll be fine!
I'll do my best in training~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Still, if it's just that...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! What if we dialed up the celebrity vibe,
just like my big sisters?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get tons of fans!
Celebrities are supposed to have followers, right?
choice_data_list: (I wonder if that's how it is?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, wouldn't it be great?
Mam's fans, Big Sis's fans,
and everyone else too..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure everyone becomes a fan of mine♪

After talking about future plans,
I stepped out of the waiting room to find...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan~! You were so cool~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone!
Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Awesome job out there! You were magnificent!
So, when's your next race? I'll be there to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Papa and Mama have work, you know. Even today, they forced it into their schedules, and their manager looked completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
Both of them are busy, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Vivlos!
No, I'll somehow keep managing from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay.
I'll go cheer as loud as I can for Mom, Dad, and Cheval too."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Thank you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama, thank you for today! I'll do my best with Trainy!

And so, with her debut successfully behind her,
it was decided that Vivlos would focus on training
while steadily gaining followers... rather, fans.
